faces.name: Graveyard Shovel
faces.oracleText: {2}, {T}: Target player exiles a card from their graveyard. If it's a creature card, you gain 2 life.

faces.name: Graveyard Trespasser
faces.oracleText:
Ward—Discard a card.
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to one target card from a graveyard. If a creature card was exiled this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Daybound (If a player casts no spells during their own turn, it becomes night next turn.)

faces.name: Graveyard Glutton
faces.oracleText:
Ward—Discard a card.
Whenever this creature enters or attacks, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. For each creature card exiled this way, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
Nightbound (If a player casts at least two spells during their own turn, it becomes day next turn.)

faces.name: Gravitational Capture
faces.oracleText:
When you encounter this phenomenon, each player reveals cards from the top of their library until they reveal a nonland permanent card with mana value 5 or less. Each player puts that card onto the battlefield under the control of the player on their left and the other cards they revealed on the bottom of their library in a random order.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon).

faces.name: Gravitational Shift
faces.oracleText:
Creatures with flying get +2/+0.
Creatures without flying get -2/-0.

faces.name: Gravitic Herald
faces.oracleText:
Lifelink
When this creature enters, seek a nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less. That card gains warp {0} until end of turn. You lose 2 life.

faces.name: Gravitic Punch
faces.oracleText:
Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target player.
Jump-start (You may cast this card from your graveyard by discarding a card in addition to paying its other costs. Then exile this card.)

faces.name: Graviton, Fundamental Force
faces.oracleText:
Whenever you draw your second card each turn, choose one —
• Target creature gains flying until end of turn. (It can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
• Tap target creature.

faces.name: Gravity Negator
faces.oracleText:
Devoid (This card has no color.)
